Low-priority targeted pass (851 pages) for energy per tonne of waste only. Loaded: EU data-collection (WT TWG 2014) specific energy per t waste treated for anaerobic digestion (electricity), outdoor and indoor composting (total), MBT (total and electricity), waste oil re-refining (total), spent solvent regeneration (total); Table 5.24 design values for TDA/HF and TDA/HF/PDA re-refining trains (electricity in main file; MP steam, fired-heater absorbed heat, hydrogen, propane in _flows); one-plant AD biogas yield 80-120 Nm3/t in _flows. Not loaded: physico-chemical treatment, WEEE/shredder, soil, water-based liquid waste and FGT residue energy figures (no archetype relevance); BAT-AELs (non-GHG); emerging techniques have no energy/cost numbers of use. All values are per tonne of WASTE input, not per unit product; most are plant-reported averages and wide ranges. Trap: MBT total energy printed as kW/t, read as kWh/t; a few other sections also print kW/t. Locator convention: printed page numbers (the Waste Treatment NNN" footers)
